_note: Tier 2, oldest end. 26 September to 1 October 2025: Sharia warnings, the China virus, the Turkey drums.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glory of God is in there, people get saved and radically born again, and that some people like their devil and hold on.
mentions.quote: They are going to get radically born again
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: conversions among unnamed people.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the glory will go onto a boat in Galveston, that he does not know when, and that he saw a Royal Caribbean ship leaving with the glory of God going out of it.
mentions.quote: I saw a Royal Caribbean boat leaving and the glory of God going on
mentions.falsify_match: A revival breaking out on a named cruise line sailing from Galveston.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named port and a named operator, which is unusually specific for the revival material.

mentions.claim_text: He opens by greeting the audience and says he wants to go over some of the things they prayed about last time before praying again.
mentions.quote: I want to go over some of the things that we prayed about last time
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: session framing.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He points to a Muslim prayer gathering held in public in America and says they are not agreeing with what is going on there.
mentions.quote: a prayer gathering for the Muslim faith coming and praying
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a news item read out.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says they can see an uptick of Sharia law, which he says is what he has been telling them is coming to America.
mentions.quote: an uptick of Sharia law coming to America
mentions.falsify_match: Islamic law adopted in any American jurisdiction.
mentions.falsify_miss: None adopted. No American jurisdiction recognises it, and state courts apply state law.

mentions.claim_text: He says to be bold about what they believe up to the point of the great persecution he says is coming, and names major cities in the nation.
mentions.quote: the point of the persecution that I told you is coming. Great persecution
mentions.falsify_match: Systematic persecution of Christians in American cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated and without a threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a walkout at the UN and someone crying, and says the Lord said they must pray for the president to stand.
mentions.quote: everybody gets up and walks out in the UN
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: the September 2025 UN General Assembly walkout, read out after the fact.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says people are saying the president is standing against Israel and calling it a great betrayal, and recalls that he said there would start to be a great betrayal.
mentions.quote: Remember I said there will start to be a great betrayal
mentions.falsify_match: American abandonment of Israel called the great betrayal.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He is applying the phrase to commentary rather than to an act.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch the fig tree, that this is a crucial week for Israel with a storm on all sides and war crimes, and mentions a leader facing arrest if he lands elsewhere.
mentions.quote: This will be a crucial week concerning Israel
mentions.falsify_match: A decisive week for Israel in late September 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: An ordinary week. The ICC warrant he refers to was issued in November 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He acknowledges atrocities on both sides and says they need to de-escalate and cause peace.
mentions.quote: there have been atrocities on both sides, but we need to deescalate
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of position, notable for conceding the point to a critic.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him they will see the swastika in a greater measure throughout Europe in the days ahead, with an attempted great escalation of war.
mentions.quote: you will see this in a greater measure in the days ahead all throughout Europe
mentions.falsify_match: A visible resurgence of Nazi symbolism across Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated and without a threshold.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen revival breaking out in China and North Korea with a great shaking first so it can happen, and reports the Lord saying it will be a small window.
mentions.quote: the Lord said it will be a small window
mentions.falsify_match: A short period of open religious activity in China and North Korea.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Small window keeps the scale deliberately low.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is telling them what he believes as his right and is not trying to cause strife, but is calling to prayer regardless.
mentions.quote: I am not here to try to cause strife
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of intent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Texas governor stood against Sharia law and a massive Muslim temple that was to be built in the Dallas area.
mentions.quote: Texas governor Abbott stood against Sharia law
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a news item read out. The development in question was a planned residential community, not a temple, and Texas has no Sharia courts to ban.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes someone jailed for a night over speaking against the Palestinians, as a warning to keep quiet.
mentions.quote: we are going to put you in jail for the night
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a case read out, with the jurisdiction not named.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says the very ring of fire and that everything is going to change, and that he sees Japan shaking.
mentions.quote: I see Japan shaking
mentions.falsify_match: A major Japanese earthquake.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Japan records about 1,500 felt quakes a year, so only a major event would count.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees a new virus again but over China, that something concerns this winter and this season, and that he sees hospitals filled.
mentions.quote: I see a new virus again, but I see it over China
mentions.falsify_match: A significant new outbreak in China during the 2025-26 winter, with hospitals filled.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurred. A named country and a named season, which makes it scoreable.

mentions.claim_text: He calls for every plot of every hidden terror cell in the nation and in Europe to be exposed, and prays no mass casualties.
mentions.quote: every hidden cell of terror organization in this nation, we call it exposed
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a petition.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the map turning red up through California as a red wave, because people are frustrated with how their government is behaving.
mentions.quote: a red wave over the state of California
mentions.falsify_match: California swinging Republican in a statewide vote.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. California has not elected a Republican statewide since 2006.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed them the face of a ministry would change a lot after the death of its founder, and that he saw gatherings on college campuses.
mentions.quote: the face of their ministry would change a lot
mentions.falsify_match: A visible change of direction at the named ministry, with campus gatherings.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Given eleven days after the killing that prompted it, when campus events were already under way.

mentions.claim_text: He says that praying two days earlier the Lord was showing them glory events and worship.
mentions.quote: the Lord was showing us glory events
mentions.falsify_match: Large worship gatherings of the kind described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. This is the earliest telling of the glory events material.

mentions.claim_text: He says it started over there and will end over there, that it is about the people of Israel and the Jewish people.
mentions.quote: It started there and it is going to end over there
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a theological position about where history ends.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He describes dividing and rumours of wars, with Russia saying it is ready to escalate and the United States responding in kind.
mentions.quote: Russia saying we are ready to kick this thing off at another level
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: current rhetoric summarised.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw Turkey beating massive war drums sounding throughout the land, and biological weapons coming up out of Israel.
mentions.quote: I saw Turkey and they started beating these massive drums
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey mobilising, with biological weapons involved.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The drums recur from January 2024.

mentions.claim_text: He says he will be a wounded brother, that Turkey and other Arab nations say you should not have done that, and that it becomes an actual foot troop war with soldiers marching.
mentions.quote: it is actually a foot troop war. I saw soldiers marching
mentions.falsify_match: A ground war between Arab states and Israel.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Ground rather than air is the distinguishing detail.

mentions.claim_text: He says the channel exists to pray and intercede, and that God shows them what to pray about and what is coming.
mentions.quote: God shows us what to pray about and what is coming
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a statement of purpose.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls being told to pray over ten major cities and over Homeland Security, the FBI and sheriff departments to uncover the demonic, and says look what happened.
mentions.quote: within 10 major cities to pray over these major cities
mentions.falsify_match: Cells uncovered across ten American cities.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He offers an unspecified news item as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He describes small conversion numbers, twenty in South Korea and five in China, and reports the Lord saying five here and twenty there add up.
mentions.quote: only get 20 people get born again in South Korea and five in China
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: reported conversion counts from the channel, with encouragement attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not a claim.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the nation and every decision, saying it will be like the Reagan era as the Lord showed him, and that they will see a blessing.
mentions.quote: this will be like the Ronald Reagan era
mentions.falsify_match: A period comparable to the Reagan years in American politics and economy.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. The comparison sets a recognisable shape.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that because of the decisions made standing with Israel on the Tuesday, they will see a greater grace and a blessing on the administration.
mentions.quote: a greater grace concerning decisions of a blessing on this administration
mentions.falsify_match: Visible benefit to the administration following its Israel stance.
mentions.falsify_miss: None attributable. Grace has no measure.
